title: ClimbingAidDef
description:
A climbing aid definition from JSON type `"climbing_aid"`.

Defines how a tile, item, or ability can be used for climbing.

abstract_.description: Abstract flag — if true, this definition is a template.

condition.description: Condition under which this climbing aid can be used.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

slip_chance_mod.description: Modifier to slip chance (negative means safer).
